title: Have you been to any of these places?
content: Hello! Okay so I am mind blown. A few weeks ago I discovered the concept of Mall World. Honestly I didn’t think anything of it until I saw a second tiktok that showed a picture of the EXACT bathrooms I see consistently. I’ve been working on a map recently (I will post once completed) and exploring this sub & have realized I am for sure in Mall World. I would love to know if anyone recognizes these places or similar please!!! 1. Whale Lake- This is a frozen type of lake (the size can vary depending on where you’re looking at it from, also sometimes has ice and waves) that has a dark brown wooden pavilion on the left side if you’re looking at it from the road . There is a stream that runs alongside a road that goes into the lake from the left also. There are mountains in the background and you ca go tubing down the stream and it winds down to the lake (I never want my tube to go into the lake because it’s scary in there) . The lake has 2 giant whales (maybe more) but 2 for sure, and when you first see them when you get in the water they’re so big all you see is black. 2. Market Road - little narrow road you can sometimes drive down (off of the super high scary highway) most of the time you would be walking. Has rows in weird patterns of little shops and restaurants that look like shacks or little shipping containers with fabric awnings. There is a restaurant that is an actual building but when you go in you have to go up a few steps and then a ramp to the booths. Normally a bit busy, red checkered table clothes on the table. Might be on the water??? I can’t remember if I’ve walked all the way to the other side to check but definitely gives beach restaurant vibes. 3. Mega Beach Hotel- I’m normally on the roof for this one, the roof either overlooks the ocean, or turns into sand and has ocean access. This is where you’ll see weird things above the water from. The hotel looks like two giant tower pillars with points at the top of both, connected by a shorter building- on top is the area where the pools and beach are. There’s obviously a lot more, but these three are the places I really want to know if other people are familiar with!! Thank you! ☺️
